title: Phase173-compatible MNP Reservation Deep Master Schema

field_notes.freshness: Separates current 2026-09-23 exact verification from carried-forward legacy evidence.
field_notes.eligibility: MNP reservation eligibility by contract class; data-only/SMS-only are never assumed eligible.
field_notes.one_stop: Whether reservation-number issuance can be skipped when the destination supports MNP One-Stop.
field_notes.reservation_number: Validity, issue timing, delivery, reissue and cancellation behavior.
field_notes.channels: Web/app/phone/store availability, hours, entry point and step sequence.
field_notes.blockers: Provider-specific conditions that prevent or delay issuance.
field_notes.special_rules: Group transfers, representative-line rules, data-plan conversion, prepaid/non-voice exceptions.
field_notes.error_states: Known error code/state, meaning and recovery path.
field_notes.official_sources: First-party URLs used for the record.
field_notes.real_account_observation: Optional SolQvia/user real-account observation layer. Must remain distinct from provider official claims and must state scope/date/limitations.

evidence_rules: current_exact records must have freshness.source_checked_at=2026-09-23 and phase171_rechecked=true
legacy carried records must preserve their prior source_checked_at date and phase171_rechecked=false
unknown issue times remain unknown rather than estimated
MNP reservation issuance is not treated as immediate source-contract cancellation
one-stop and reservation-number flows remain separate
real_account_observation must never be promoted to a provider SLA or universal rule unless independently confirmed by official provider evidence
where official evidence independently confirms an observed condition, store both layers and document the reconciliation
